- **G? [M] Walkability: only the car ground, hatched, and its stretch on the route** (2026-11-19) · Earn · aligned
  Area: walkability, layers, walk-screen. From: /investigate, the owner's ask (2026-11-19), a phone screenshot. Brief: docs/research/walkability-car-ground.md.
  Calls: only the car ground is drawn (amends 0096); a soft hatch with a smooth edge; the route marks its stretch and the pill's icon matches. Decision 0232.
  Touches: VISION.md Always, "Guidance is structural ... never whether it is good" and "Restraint in motion, colour and copy"; Never, "Nagging: off-route alarms"; decisions 0096 (amended by 0232), 0097; UF9-UF11, WH8, WH13.
  The slice: 1. With the Walkability layer on, ground built around cars is drawn and ground easy on foot is not (the plain map); the cells' rule and the area card's words are unchanged. 2. The car ground is a soft diagonal hatch in slate with a firm edge line, the streets and labels readable through it, never red or orange, readable without colour. 3. Neighbouring car cells are drawn as one area with rounded edges, no 250 m steps, from a core function of the cells (deterministic, never stored, O(n log n)). 4. The edge of what was read never draws an edge of car ground. 5. The legend shows one row, "Built around cars", its swatch the hatch as drawn and its icon in the same slate. 6. While navigating with the layer on, the route's stretch inside car ground is drawn with a slate casing under the route's own colour, from the runs the heads-up already finds; with the layer off it is not. 7. The heads-up's icon is the same slate, not the accent; its words, timing and silence are unchanged (WH7, WH8). 8. Nothing touches the route: no reroute, no "avoid", no sound or haptic (WH13). 9. No number, count, share or rank anywhere (UF12). 10. The same on the web and the native map; native recorded as never run on a device.
  Precedent: Komoot ties a route warning to the section it applies to; AccessMap marks the exception on the path, not the norm; aviation charts hatch restricted airspace along its boundary; Google Maps says it in words only (all unverified, docs/research/adjacent-apps.md, "Mark ground that is hard on foot"). Departs from AccessMap's red: a soft slate, since the ground is described, not judged.
  Payoff: every navigated walk with the layer on, and the Explore and Navigate maps; makes the heads-up readable. Cost: M; `components/map/types.ts`, both map renderers, a new core module, the layers registry, `WalkBandIcon`; new native fill-pattern code (unverified). Reopens: walkability, layers, map. After it: a quiet label inside large car areas, if the hatch alone does not say it.
  Instead: recolour the pill's icon and draw only the car ground as a flat smoothed tint (criteria 1, 3, 5, 7).
